title: Xbox considers hourly fees for streaming owned games
excerpt: Xbox is reportedly exploring a time-based payment model that would charge players hourly to stream games they already own.
body_html:
Xbox is reportedly looking into a time-based pricing structure for cloud gaming. Under this approach, players would face hourly charges ranging from 24 to 40 cents to stream titles they have already purchased.

These proposed a la carte fees would apply in addition to the initial purchase price of the games. The potential model introduces hourly streaming costs for users who want to play their library via the cloud rather than running them locally on hardware.
